content.text: {"id": "mm6524a3", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, an HIV test was performed at 1.0% of visits made by young males"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "with higher testing rates among black males (2.7%) and Hispanic males (1.4%), compared with white males (0.7%)"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "During 2009–2012, males aged 15–39 years made an average of 1.4 visits per year to physicians’ offices."}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, an HIV test was performed at 1.0% of visits made by young males"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, an HIV test was performed at 1.0% of visits made by young males"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "HIV testing was reported at 2.7% of visits by black males (prevalence ratio [PR] = 3.8; p<0.001)"}, {"loc": "table 2", "q": "Univariate logistic regression model used to estimate prevalence ratios."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "A four-stage probability sampling design is used in NAMCS"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The average annual visits per person were calculated by dividing average annual number of visits during 2009-–2012"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "was calculated by subtracting the average annual number of visits in which an HIV test was not performed"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "This methodology was used because the outcome, visits with an HIV test, had unweighted cell sizes <30 for several subgroups."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "All analyses used weighting to account for the complex sampling design."}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Univariate logistic regression model used to estimate prevalence ratios."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
